entries.name: Reliafy
entries.summary: Open-source reliability engineering web app (AGPL-3.0 core) that fits life-distribution models to failure data and links every RCM maintenance decision to the analysis that justifies it, revalidating those links when new failure data arrives.
features: RCM studies structured as Function → Functional failure → Failure mode worksheets with effects, consequences and maintenance decisions
Each maintenance decision links to the fitted life model, cost-optimal replacement analysis, degradation model or availability calculation that supports it
Live revalidation marks decisions as supported, unverified or contradicted when new failure data changes the underlying evidence
Life-distribution modelling with Weibull, Exponential, Normal, Lognormal, Gamma and proportional-hazards models for exact, censored and truncated data
Reliability block diagrams with series, parallel, k-out-of-n and standby arrangements, system reliability, MTTF, importance measures and minimal cut sets
Maintenance strategy comparison and cost-optimal preventive-replacement interval calculation
Datasets and saved models reusable across analyses; RCM worksheets export to CSV for reports and audits
deployment: Self-hosted via docker compose, served on a single port
Single-user self-host mode with no login page
MongoDB persistence with an in-memory fallback when MongoDB is unavailable
Hosted cloud edition adds accounts, team workspaces and an optional AI assistant; the core codebase remains AGPL-3.0

leaf_matches.reason: Official README and RCM product page describe Function → Functional failure → Failure mode worksheets in which every maintenance decision cites the fitted life model, cost-optimal replacement analysis, degradation model or availability calculation, with live revalidation when failure data changes; together with maintenance-strategy optimisation and CSV export this covers the failure-knowledge-to-strategy loop in a complete self-hostable web application.

entries.name: Relyence RCM
entries.summary: Commercial browser-based Reliability Centered Maintenance analysis software for building RCM decision diagrams and worksheets, recording failure consequences and maintenance tasks, and developing standards-based maintenance strategies.

leaf_matches.reason: Official RCM product page shows browser-based RCM analysis with decision diagrams, worksheets, failure consequences and maintenance task schedules, FMEA data integration and SAE JA1011/JA1012, MIL-HDBK-2173 and NAVAIR templates, matching the failure-evaluation-to-maintenance-strategy core; the page also evidences no-download trial access, confirming an application service rather than only a desktop client.
